applicable_when: The GEMM is tiny: M=10, N=1000, K=128. With BLOCK_M=16, BLOCK_N=32, BLOCK_K=128 the grid is only 32 tiles — less than 1/4 of the 132 SMs on H200. Achieved occupancy collapses to 6.2% (vs 56.2% theoretical) because most SMs sit idle. The scheduler is idle 92% of cycles. Additionally, 17-way shared memory bank conflicts waste 82% of shared load wavefronts. The fix is to add @triton.autotune with configurations that: (a) use smaller BLOCK_M/BLOCK_N to produce more tiles and fill more SMs, (b) increase num_warps to hide latency, (c) vary BLOCK_K and num_stages to pipeline memory loads and reduce bank conflicts.
